scenarios.scenario_abstract: While organizing an outdoor luncheon for twenty-five golf friends, [X] considers cat-eye sunglasses within a playful dress theme and compares lens colors by afternoon glare, coordination with the group palette, whether eyes and expressions remain visible, and how the whole group reads in photographs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为 25 位高尔夫球友筹办户外午宴时，[X]会在趣味着装主题中考虑猫眼太阳镜，并根据午后眩光、与集体配色的协调、眼睛和表情是否仍清晰可见，以及合照中的整体效果来比较镜片颜色。
examples: using Gray, Brown, or Black when neutral glare reduction should not become another costume element
using Red, Orange, Green, or Pink only when the tint supports the agreed theme without hiding expressions
testing Clear, Blue, or Silver against actual afternoon light and group photographs rather than choosing from a swatch

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Across a dim classroom, books, a phone, computer work, and bright outdoor PE, [X] repeatedly wears and cleans the same prescription glasses for nearsightedness, using that familiar pair to judge how a future lens color would affect text, color cast, brightness, facial visibility, and transitions between indoor and outdoor use.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在昏暗教室、阅读、手机、电脑学习和明亮的户外体育课中，[X]会反复佩戴并清洁同一副近视处方眼镜，并借这副熟悉的眼镜判断未来镜片颜色会怎样影响文字、色偏、亮度、面部可见度以及室内外切换。
examples: using Clear for ordinary correction, reading, and face visibility
using Gray, Brown, or Black for bright outdoor PE only when the tint is removed before dim study spaces
treating Amber, Yellow, or Blue as trial directions whose effect on text and screen color must be checked rather than assumed

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning a Tracer cosplay, [X] compares modifying pilot or welding goggles, fabricating parts, and buying a kit, judging lens color by character recognition, visibility through the goggles, harmony with the orange headpiece and blue-lit prop, indoor convention lighting, and photographs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在规划 Tracer cosplay 时，[X]会比较改造飞行员或焊接护目镜、自制零件和购买套件，并根据角色辨识度、透过镜片的可视性、与橙色头饰及蓝色发光道具的协调、展会室内光线和照片效果来判断镜片颜色。
examples: using Orange when the signature goggle cue must remain immediately recognizable
testing Amber or Yellow as accessible warm substitutes without sacrificing visibility
rejecting Clear, Blue, or another tint when the complete costume no longer reads as the intended character

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a solo week in Maui, [X] plans repeated reef snorkeling, historical stops, resort time, coastal drives, and sunsets, comparing lens colors across a water mask and surface sunglasses by underwater color fidelity, open-water glare, changing light, facial visibility, and the need to switch rather than force one tint through the entire day.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 独自前往毛伊岛一周时，[X]会安排多次珊瑚礁浮潜、历史景点、度假村活动、海岸驾驶和日落行程，并在水下镜和水面太阳镜之间，根据水下色彩还原、开阔水面眩光、光线变化、面部可见度以及是否需要切换而非全天强用一种色调来比较镜片颜色。
examples: using Clear, Blue, or Green only when underwater visibility and reef-color judgment remain reliable
using Gray, Brown, or Black for exposed boat and shore periods while changing before lower light
testing Amber or Yellow for contrast without assuming that a warm cast suits both reef and sunset

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With a one-hundred-dollar total budget and computer use as the only stated purpose, [X] compares lens colors by text and interface fidelity, room light, facial visibility, prescription needs, anti-reflection priorities, and whether a noticeable color cast provides enough benefit to justify taking money away from the frame or core lens features.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 购买电脑眼镜的总预算为一百美元，且唯一明确用途是电脑使用；[X]会根据文字与界面色彩还原、室内光线、面部可见度、处方需求、防反射优先级，以及明显色偏是否值得挤占镜框或核心镜片功能的预算来比较镜片颜色。
examples: using Clear when correction, anti-reflection, and faithful screen color are sufficient
testing Amber or Yellow only when a visible warm cast remains acceptable across documents and images
treating Blue as a color direction rather than evidence that an unspecified filter is medically necessary

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an open-air R&B stadium concert, [X] uses sunglasses during sunny arrival, dancing, crowd movement, and photography before storing them after dark under a strict clear-bag policy, comparing lens colors by glare, eye visibility, outfit coordination, phone-screen readability, and low-light usefulness.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加露天 R&B 体育场演唱会时，[X]会在阳光下入场、跳舞、拥挤移动和拍照时佩戴太阳镜，并在天黑后按严格透明包规定收纳，再根据眩光、眼睛可见度、与服装的协调、手机屏幕可读性和弱光实用性比较镜片颜色。
examples: using Gray or Brown for a neutral sunny arrival before removing the glasses after dark
using Black or Silver only when the stronger visual statement does not erase the eyes in photographs
testing Pink, Red, or Blue as an R&B styling accent against the actual outfit and stadium light

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a tightly scheduled June trip to Sedona, [X] considers sunglasses for sunrise hikes, exposed red-rock trails, shops, swimming, Grand Canyon viewpoints, driving, and photographs, comparing lens colors by heat and glare relief, faithful reading of rock and trail contrast, screen visibility, and how the landscape appears in memories and pictures.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 六月前往塞多纳进行紧凑行程时，[X]会考虑为日出徒步、暴露的红岩步道、购物、游泳、大峡谷观景、驾驶和拍照携带太阳镜，并根据高温与眩光缓解、岩石和步道对比的真实呈现、屏幕可见度以及记忆和照片中的景观效果来比较镜片颜色。
examples: using Gray or Brown when neutral glare control should preserve red-rock color cues
testing Amber or Yellow when stronger trail contrast is useful without turning every scene unnaturally warm
checking Green, Blue, Red, or Pink against landscape recognition and photographs rather than treating scenery as a color swatch

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning a Table Mountain hike with a partner in Cape Town's rapidly changing late-April weather, [X] compares sunglass lens colors across exposed sun, cloud, wind, shaded forest, rock scrambling, summit views, and a possible cable-car descent, prioritizing safe contrast and visibility over keeping one dark tint on all day.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与伴侣计划在开普敦四月下旬多变天气中徒步桌山时，[X]会在暴晒、云层、强风、林荫、岩石攀爬、山顶视野和可能乘缆车下山等条件间比较太阳镜镜片颜色，并优先考虑安全对比度和可见性，而不是全天坚持同一种深色镜片。
examples: using Clear in deep shade or heavy cloud when tint would hide footing
using Gray, Brown, or Green in open sun when terrain colors and contrast remain legible
testing Amber or Yellow for variable light while rejecting Black or Silver when conditions turn too dark

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a quiet, moderate-budget trip to El Gouna, [X] plans to read, sketch boats and lagoon reflections, paint morning water and sunset colors, cycle, and take one boat or snorkeling outing, comparing lens colors by glare comfort and whether observed colors can still be transferred faithfully to a sketchbook.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 以适中预算前往 El Gouna 安静旅行时，[X]会安排阅读、速写船只和泻湖倒影、描绘清晨水色与日落、骑行，并选择一次乘船或浮潜活动；镜片颜色会根据眩光舒适度以及眼前颜色能否真实转移到画本上来比较。
examples: using Clear or Gray when paint mixing and observed color fidelity matter most
testing Brown, Amber, Yellow, or Orange during high glare or sunset without copying the cast into the artwork
using Blue, Green, Pink, or Red only as an intentional viewing mood that can be separated from the subject's actual color

scenarios.scenario_abstract: At a next-day Cartier optometrist visit, [X] wears a simple knit and wool coat and arrives in midday light to compare candidate glasses, judging lens colors by facial visibility, skin and clothing color, indoor-to-daylight change, intended correction or sun use, and whether the lens competes with the frame's luxury detailing.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 第二天去验光店试戴 Cartier 候选眼镜时，[X]会穿简洁针织衫和羊毛大衣并选择中午光线，根据面部可见度、肤色与服装色彩、室内外光线变化、处方或遮阳用途，以及镜片是否抢过镜框奢华细节来比较镜片颜色。
examples: using Clear when the frame and face should remain the visual focus for ordinary correction
testing Gray, Brown, or Black when the candidate is intended for sun and still works beside the coat
testing Blue, Green, Pink, Red, or Silver in both shop light and daylight before accepting a stronger fashion statement
